credit_line: Gift of Peter Stein, Fred Stein Archive
description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe sitting in profile at her dining room (plywood) table at Ghost Ranch with one hand on a book on the table and the other is bent at her waist;  her hair is pulled back in a bun and she is wearing a black wrap dress (with a white wrap dress underneath) and her Hector Aguilar suede and sterling silver belt; light from the window is visible in viewer left.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
